cards.card_text: Then a Selah lands right there in the song.
cards.verse_text: Selah May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
cards.snippet: Selah May He give you the desires of your heart and make all…

cards.card_text: David tells the LORD how that went, and then comes a Selah.
Then David speaks right to God: "who seek Your face, O God of Jacob." That's Jacob, the man God renamed Israel (Genesis 35:10), and then comes one little word: Selah.
And with one last Selah, the psalm rests right there.
The writer keeps going: "This is the fate of the foolish…" Then the psalm marks a Selah.
After a Selah, God Himself speaks: "Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God." Oof, testify AGAINST you.
cards.verse_text: Selah “Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.
cards.snippet: Selah “Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I…

cards.card_text: Then comes the word Selah, and the song keeps going.
Then comes a Selah, and David turns to his own soul and tells it to rest in God alone.
cards.verse_text: Selah Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
cards.snippet: Selah Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from…

cards.card_text: Then comes a Selah, and a brand new invitation: "Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind."
cards.verse_text: All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.
cards.snippet: …You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds…

cards.card_text: After another Selah, a new call goes out: "Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard." This psalm just hit REPLY-ALL on the whole world.
cards.verse_text: Selah Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard.
cards.snippet: Selah Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be…

cards.card_text: After a Selah, the song says WHY it wants all that blessing.
cards.verse_text: May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
cards.snippet: …us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah

cards.card_text: Then the song hits a Selah.
cards.verse_text: Selah You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.
cards.snippet: Selah You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.

cards.verse_text: Selah His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.
cards.snippet: Selah His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.
